description: Council reappointed five members to Environmental Advisory Committee until 2026.

chips.text: Received as information
Darren Hill, Manvi Ghai, Ian Judd-Henrey, Colleen Steele, Siobhan Takala reappointed.
Approved

description: Appoints a volunteer to the Environmental Grant Program committee.
Committee reviews applications for city environmental grants.

chips.text: Approved
A councillor volunteered to serve on the adjudication committee.

description: Meewasin's 2025 tree planting goals pending budget.
Committee requested Climate Action Progress Report update.

chips.text: Meewasin representative Erica clarified past tree planting goals and funding.
Residents benefit from 7,500 trees planted at Chief Whitecap Park and other sites.
Committee members questioned if CEC grants have funded Meewasin in the past.
Meewasin representative declared a potential conflict of interest regarding City funding.
Staff committed to presenting the Climate Action Progress Report at the next meeting.

description: Advisory Committee maintains two subcommittees for 2025.
Appoints members to Education and Water Conservation subcommittees.

chips.text: Approved
Committee discussed deferring membership appointments until after the work plan is finalized.
Members of the advisory committee will serve on the subcommittees.
The specific mandate of the Water Conservation subcommittee was questioned.
Committee members expressed concerns about city water quality and future resources.
Staff committed to provide information on a past water quality presentation.

description: Saskatoon Environmental Advisory Committee to draft 2025 Work Plan.
Submit plan to Council by March 31, 2025.

chips.text: Approved
Staff advised committee against direct collaboration with Saskatoon Cycles.
Committee questioned if assisting Meewasin with tree planting fits its mandate.
Work plan includes advising on National Urban Park cooperation with Indigenous communities.
Committee to advise on waste reduction, urban heat islands, and blue-green infrastructure.

description: Allocates $7,000 for education and $800 for training in 2025.

chips.text: Approved
Council confirmed flexibility to reallocate funds between education and training categories.
